info.description: Self-contained, production-grade Postman API test suite for the Simple-Senbet Sunday School platform. Fully covers authentication, school bootstrap discovery, academic year and class prerequisites, draft session creation, duplicate slot collision prevention, atomic roster submission, 24-hour mark correction window, administrative overrides with audit logs, session closure lifecycle protection, daily attendance summary reports with absentee rosters, and negative authorization boundaries.
